noticias.titular: Pavin Smith's game-ending homer gives D-backs playoff hope
noticias.texto: Pavin Smith, a former highly-touted prospect who was waived by the Diamondbacks two months ago, may have saved Arizona's season with a walk-off homer vs. the Yankees to stay alive in the wild card race.

noticias.titular: Cal Quantrill exits Rangers' victory after just 12 pitches
noticias.texto: Texas Rangers veteran starter Cal Quantrill, who is 9-5 this season, left Saturday night's game against the Toronto Blue Jays after facing just four batters because of right lat tightness.

noticias.titular: Judge hopes to be back for October; no timeline for return
noticias.texto: New York Yankees slugger Aaron Judge hopes to be back in time for the playoffs next month but is unsure on a definitive timeline.

noticias.titular: Brewers edge O's to tie team record for wins in a season with 97
noticias.texto: The Milwaukee Brewers tied a team record with their 97th win of the season, beating Baltimore 1-0.
